title: Real Madrid: How Could I Not Love You

1.name: If you achieve the impossible
1.ov: The last period experienced by Real Madrid, with six Champions League titles in a decade, portrays it as a unique case in the history of sports, the exhibition of a competitive gene that defies logic. With Carlo Ancelotti in charge and the addition of new stars like Bellingham, the team faces the challenge of every year: achieving the impossible.

1.name: If you make me happy
1.ov: Bellingham has dazzled since his first match. His journey from Birmingham, where he spent his childhood and youth, to the Santiago Bernabéu reveals a unique talent that embraces pressure. The English player erupts as a goal scorer. The El Clásico at Montjuic, with an iconic goal by the Englishman and his embrace with Luka Modric, marks him as the new star of a team that never stops dreaming.

1.name: If I keep dreaming you
1.ov: Wearing the colours of Real Madrid is a dream, but it can also entail a weight that not everyone can withstand. Dani Carvajal and Nacho Fernández embody a generational lesson that inspires the youngest. The team wins the Spanish Super Cup brilliantly and keeps making progress in the Champions League.

1.name: If you slay dragons for me
1.ov: Real Madrid confronts Manchester City once again. After the heavy defeat at the Etihad the previous year, the team must overcome the challenge this season. Rüdiger, Nacho and Lunin become the unexpected heroes in an epic penalty shootout that redeems Carlo and defines the greatness of a club in which it is always clear that no one is stronger than all of them together.

1.name: If you make me feel at home
1.ov: The Santiago Bernabéu is not just a stadium. It's a magical place where dreams come true and the impossible happens. The real magic turns up in the second leg of the Champions League semi-finals against Bayern Munich, where the stadium comes together to form a new unforgettable feat. It is also Joselu's night, who had always dreamed about succeeding in Real Madrid.

1.name: How could I not love you?
1.ov: Courtois is back to conquer the national league and to support the team between the sticks in the first half of the Champions League final against Dortmund. It's the sixth European Champions League, for Kroos and Nacho, who achieved the perfect goodbye, and for Modric and Carvajal. Real Madrid looks to the future to keep dreaming and with Mbappé as a new star on the horizon.
